name: NJP Associates
what_they_do: One-adviser financial planning practice (Norman J. Politziner, CFP) covering financial, retirement and investment planning, insurance, transition planning, estate/trust work and business succession planning. Investment advisory services are offered through Koehler Asset Management.
customers: Individuals and families, pre-retirees and retirees, and business owners in northern/central NJ

size_signals.signal: More than 40 years serving Highland Park per site copy; one principal adviser named
Named adviser profile page for Norman J. Politziner, CFP, MBA, CeFT
Specialised service pages for retirees, individuals/families, transition planning, insurance and investments

website_review.primary_cta: None - the 'Contact Us' nav item leads to a page-not-found screen
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: No - no form and no booking; phone/email only, and only in the footer
website_review.trust_signals: 40+ years in business, CFP/CeFT credentials, client login portal, compliance disclosures naming Koehler Asset Management
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Contact Us page returns 'Page not found' and only shows contact details in the site footer; footer copyright reads 2026 so the site is maintained, but the contact path is broken
website_review.search_basics: Titles are generic ('Home | NJP Associates.'), no meta description on the home page, no schema markup, service pages exist with descriptive URLs
top_issues: The Contact Us page 404s ('Page not found'), leaving no working contact path except the footer
No contact form, no click-to-call tel: link anywhere, no online booking
Mobile hero is a stock forest photo with an inspirational quote - no service statement, no CTA
Zero structured data and no meta description; GBP category is 'Insurance agency' rather than financial planner, and there are no reviews

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt blocks only MJ12bot/VelenPublicWebCrawler and internal paths, so Googlebot/OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot are fine. GBP exists with address, phone and hours but the category looks wrong for the business. Address, phone and services are readable text, though there is no JSON-LD at all and no fee/price range. Because the contact page 404s and there is no form, an agent cannot submit anything or book.

operations_signals.signal: Single-adviser practice where intake depends on a phone call and an info@ mailbox; the only online contact route is broken
Site offers a client account login and financial calculator library, suggesting existing clients self-serve while new-client intake is manual

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the broken Contact Us page and add a qualified intake form (goal, investable assets, timeline) with auto-reply and calendar booking
top_opportunities.evidence: /contact-us returns 'Page not found'; no form anywhere on the site and no tel: links

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rewrite the mobile hero to state the offer (retirement/transition planning in Highland Park) with a call CTA instead of a stock-photo quote
top_opportunities.evidence: 390px screenshot shows only a lake/forest photo and the quote 'Serenity starts with a POSITIVE action'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness/FinancialService schema with address, phone and areaServed, fix the Google category to financial planner, and start collecting reviews
top_opportunities.evidence: No JSON-LD on any page checked; GBP categorised as 'Insurance agency' with no reviews shown

scores.reasons: Gap: broken contact page, no form, no schema, no reviews - several basic misses for a 40-year practice. Ability to pay: fee-based advisory practice with long-tenured high-net-worth clients (inference from positioning). Ease: small static site, fixes are quick. Evidence: home, contact page, robots.txt and GBP checked directly.
